issues.description: test-install-scripts: 'dnf search python3.12' adds noise and can fail-mask intent
issues.detail: Adding `dnf search python3.12` in Amazon Linux and Rocky preparation steps performs a search that is unrelated to installation. It clutters CI logs and provides no guarantee that python3.12 is actually available before install. Either drop the search or replace with `dnf list available python3.12` and check the exit code.

issues.description: Stale `default_raise` comment/function references <3.10 compat that is now removed
issues.detail: `default_raise` in chia/wallet/wallet_request_types.py still says 'just for < 3.10 compatibility', and the long comment above TransactionEndpointRequest references '< 3.10 compatibility'. Since 3.9 support is gone, these notes are misleading and the helper's documented rationale no longer applies. Update or remove to avoid confusing future maintainers.

issues.description: install.sh version-check threshold not raised to match new minimum
issues.detail: After bumping minimum to 3.10, the guard `[ "$PYTHON_MINOR_VER" -lt "7" ]` still accepts 3.7-3.9 silently if somehow detected, contradicting the printed error message 'requires Python version >= 3.10'. Change the comparison to `-lt "10"` to actually enforce the new minimum.

issues.description: New ruff UP045/UP007/UP035 ignores added without tracking
issues.detail: The TODO in ruff.toml broadly disables Optional/Union/typing upgrade rules with no linked issue. Given the PR description says Union types 'will soon not be supported', tracking these suppressions in an issue would prevent them from becoming permanent.

`zip(ordered, ordered[1:])` was replaced with `itertools.pairwise(ordered)`. Verify itertools is imported at module top; if it was only used transitively before, the test will raise NameError. A quick grep of the file should confirm.

issues.description: dnf update -y on every CI run slows pipelines and risks drift
issues.detail: The new Amazon/Rocky prep steps run `dnf update -y` before installing, which can pull in unrelated package upgrades on every install-script test run, increasing runtime and making CI less reproducible. Consider dropping `dnf update -y` and relying on the base image plus a targeted install.

review.summary: This PR cleanly drops Python 3.9 across CI, install scripts, packaging, and code, simplifying conditional dataclass wrappers. Main concerns are around the test-install-scripts changes (extraneous `dnf search` and `dnf update -y` adding noise/runtime), an install.sh version guard still using `-lt 7` instead of `-lt 10`, and lingering "< 3.10 compatibility" comments/helpers in wallet_request_types.py that are now stale. The new ruff `UP045/UP007/UP035` ignores should be tracked with an issue. Also worth double-checking the `itertools.pairwise` change includes the proper import.
